summary: First test run of ASKOOL MVP. Wrote a pytest suite with 27 backend test cases covering public meta/educators/jobs, auth (admin login, register educator/parent/school, me, forgot, logout), RBAC (educator can't POST /jobs, school can't POST /applications, non-admin can't GET /admin/stats, unauth /auth/me), educator flow (profile upsert + get + apply + status transitions + duplicate protection), school flow (schools/me, jobs, applications received), parent flow (students, tutoring-requests + matches with match_score/reasons), bookings, reviews (rating aggregate updates educator profile), favorites toggle, messaging (create conv + list + read messages), notifications (list + unread + mark read), verification (submit + admin approve sets is_verified true), admin stats/users, subscriptions (returns pending_payment mobile_money). All 27 backend tests PASS. Also ran Playwright UI tests: Landing loads, /educateurs shows 8 seeded educator cards, Voir le profil opens detail with Contacter + Demander un cours buttons, /emplois shows 7 jobs with data-testid job-card-* and view-job-*, admin login lands on /dashboard with Vue générale (17 users, 4 schools, 9 educators, 3 parents/apprenants), new educator registration via /inscription lands on /dashboard, 6 side-nav items open without JS errors.

minor.issue: pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD (reserved). Real emails work; only affects tests using synthetic domains. Not a code bug.

issues: Multiple 401 console errors on public pages caused by /api/auth/me being called with no token; consider suppressing 401 log or gating call on presence of cookie/token to reduce console noise.

action_items: (optional) Suppress /api/auth/me 401 console errors on public pages by not calling it unless a session hint exists (localStorage flag or cookie presence).
(optional) Educator detail page views counter increments per public GET — consider debouncing to avoid inflated views from bots/reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 776 lines mixing all domains; consider splitting into routers (educators.py, schools.py, jobs.py, applications.py, etc.) once feature-complete.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router() — works in FastAPI because middlewares are stacked at startup, but adding it before include_router is conventional and less error-prone.
verify_password uses bcrypt.checkpw with silent Exception→False; ok, but log the exception for observability of malformed hashes.
brute-force lockout keyed on ip:email uses request.client.host which is the proxy IP in K8s ingress; consider X-Forwarded-For handling so lockout is per real client.
In educator_public/other endpoints, _id is excluded ({'_id': 0}) — good. Confirmed no ObjectId leaks in tested responses.
notify() writes read=False notifications synchronously per action — fine at MVP scale; move to background_task if volume grows.
Duplicate-application check is by (offer_id, educator_user_id) at read time — could race under concurrent posts; add a compound unique index applications(offer_id, educator_user_id).
reviews.POST does not check that the author is not the educator themselves; add self-review protection.
bookings.PUT status accepts any string; consider whitelist of statuses (Confirmé/Refusé/Terminé/Annulé) like APP_STATUSES.
subscriptions marks is_premium=True on plan 'Premium/Pro' as soon as record is created with status pending_payment; premium should be granted only after payment confirmation.
